items.title: Crypto rises with Asian tech stocks, zcash extends gain after setting upgrade date
items.summary: Bitcoin rose to a one-week high as Asian tech stocks rebounded and SpaceX and Tesla formed committees to explore a merger.

items.title: Solana’s Alpenglow launches on mainnet, targets 99% faster finality
items.summary: Solana’s first major consensus upgrade is targeting 99% finality reduction, seeking to offer users near-immediate transaction settlement and more responsive applications.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin slumps below $82,000 as markets go risk off on AI selloff, oil surge
items.summary: South Korea's Kospi tumbled 3.5% overnight, and oil gained nearly 3% on renewed Middle East hostilities.

items.title: The UK needs a workable route to regulated DeFi access
items.summary: The UK’s 2027 crypto rules risk a de facto ban on regulated firms providing access to DeFi, argues Coinbase’s European policy head Katie Harries.

items.title: PHP Foundation admits ‘structural failure’ delayed critical security fix
items.summary: Government websites and online services were disrupted after concerns about a PHP bug that could allow attackers to take control of vulnerable servers.

items.title: Bitcoin risk management grows more popular as the 'just bet on price' era fades
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Oct. 21, 2026

items.title: Monero futures are again heating with leverage, raising volatility risks
items.summary: Open interest has topped $300 million and price is back above $600. A similar setup was seen before January's crash.

items.title: Cardano Foundation urges EU against expanding MiCA rules to DeFi and staking
items.summary: The foundation called for regulation based on financial risks rather than technology, warning that overlapping rules could create uncertainty for crypto businesses across the EU.

items.title: 5 alternatives to Ledger to store your Bitcoin
items.summary: Hardware wallets aren’t the only way to protect your crypto, but from ETFs and passkeys to multisig accounts, each alternative has its own risks and trade-offs.

items.title: SequenceHash: multihashing for the rest of us
items.summary: Multihashing is one of those cryptographic tasks that’s easy not to think about too much. This is unfortunate, because multihashing is a common stumbling point when cryptographers try to use hashes. As part of our goal to “fix software, not bugs,” Trail of Bits is introducing Seq

items.title: Ethereum’s four-minute settlement plan could lower the cost of moving crypto
items.summary: A new draft targets a fourfold cut in the time it takes Ethereum transactions to become final, which could free up money transfer services tie up while customers’ payments clear.

items.title: Crypto traders seek shelter in bitcoin as altcoins slide and ETF flows wobble
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Oct. 21, 2026

items.title: Bitcoin slides below $82,000 as AI doubts return, with DeFi tokens leading declines
items.summary: Bitcoin as much as 2.9% to around $81,600 as Nasdaq futures dropped, while the CoinDesk 80 lost 3.5% and DeFi index slid 6%.

items.title: Crypto traders price India telecoms company Reliance Jio's IPO at about $110 billion
items.summary: The pre-IPO Jio contract on Bitget is trading near $12, a roughly 4% premium on the top price band, as India’s largest public offering remains open for subscription.

items.title: Asian stocks tumble, bitcoin retreats as China enters bear market
items.summary: Technology shares led regional losses as mixed U.S. earnings unsettled investors and Brent crude climbed above $112 a barrel.

items.title: China seeks to seize 61,800 BTC tied to $5.7 billion fraud scheme
items.summary: Chinese prosecutors are seeking to confiscate more than 61,800 Bitcoin tied to a $5.7 billion fraud scheme, days after a U.K. court ruled Chinese law governs victims’ claims to the coins.

items.title: Solana’s biggest network change since 2020 is live. Here’s how users benefit
items.summary: The new voting system targets settlement in about 150 milliseconds, potentially shortening waits for payments and deposits. Users can keep their existing wallets.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs attract $1.08 billion in 3 days but it may not be enough for a steep rally
items.summary: Past steep rallies ran on about $235 million a day of net inflows into ETFs. The funds are yet to match that pace, according to data analyzed by CoinDesk.

items.title: XRP Ledger bug fix moved to November after validator support dipped for two hours
items.summary: The fix lost its two-week countdown less than two days from the finish after support slipped to 26 of 35 validators. It’s now back at 31.

items.title: Bitcoin gives back its run at $85,000 as Tesla and Meta fail to calm AI nerves
items.summary: BTC broke through its $84,000 ceiling late Wednesday, then slid back to the $82,500 support analysts are watching as tech futures fell.
